binder_algorithm.fresh_exhausted: UNKNOWN, never forced capture or profile name invention
binder_algorithm.log: only actual from!=to changes; TEMPLATE_BINDER variable_id ID, ABSTRACTION_CAPTURE variable_id null; include call_path and full location
binder_algorithm.native_abstraction: simultaneous substitution removes shadowed binder mapping. Active replacements only keys free in body. If binder in union of active replacement free names, first allowed host variable outside all_names(body)|replacement_free_names|mapping_keys; rename bound occurrences capture-safely then apply original reduced map simultaneously
binder_algorithm.template: desired=env[binder_id]. Forbidden is body external free names under lexical template BOUND IDs plus active native bound names. Meta body free names exclude formal_names; recurse actual arguments, free template VARIABLEs and all constructors. Keep desired if allowed; otherwise first host.variable_names outside forbidden. Variable uses resolve nearest lexical ID, not matching literal strings

callback_scope: trusted synchronous caller tick and candidate iterator; external exceptions propagate. No clocks/cancellation conversion, hidden visits reset or fresh native language construction
costs: hypothesis_nodes counts root materialized ports only; explicit body assumption nodes counted in primitive_nodes. No unique physical placement/marking cost claim before host row/key union validation
descriptor_version: receptor-lemma-family-v2 is additive and intentionally not auto-converted from frozen design-v1; typed argument wrappers, child ordered_hypotheses and explicit call-output refs required

deterministic_order.call_frames: preorder, root call_path=[], child appends call step ID; substitutions and every ordered port/output retained
deterministic_order.nested_hypotheses: reuse passed original Gamma node; child mappings must retain exact original occurrence and literal formula. Inputs never become hypotheses/facts
deterministic_order.nodes: n0,n1,...; root hypothesis assumption nodes first in declared order, then recursive body order; no automatic primitive/node dedup
deterministic_order.primitive_arguments: instantiated in sorted argument-name order; child parameter bindings in child declaration order
deterministic_order.recursive_locations: template fields append field names/index; native substitution appends native AST integer indices. Call path disambiguates nested frames
deterministic_order.root_hypotheses: always materialized once per original root hypothesis port, even unused, rule assumption/arguments index; origin step_id=null, hypothesis_port ID, gamma_index int
deterministic_order.side_checks: postorder per completed call frame (child before parent), automatic VARIABLE checks in parameter declaration order (AUTO_DISTINCT then AUTO_EIGEN for that parameter), then explicit condition indices in declaration order

matching_update.confirmation: every complete inferred/supplied environment passes complete expand() including exact all-port native literal matching, every body/output/scope condition; failed candidate never excludes a base placement
matching_update.errors: registry/host errors propagate; each binding-level DescriptorError yields its code. UNBOUND_UNKNOWN is unfinished, despite historical list key rejected_bindings. External iterator and tick exceptions propagate; wrapped ticks cannot be mistaken for internal DescriptorError
matching_update.inference: native VARIABLE names, predicate names, TERM/FORMULA abstractions only when explicit argument terms instantiate to distinct native variables, including zero-arity; literal constructor matching throughout
matching_update.nonpattern: no inverse guess through non-variable/repeated actual arguments. Candidate iterator can supply full abstractions; unresolved parameters get UNBOUND_UNKNOWN and no expansion
matching_update.order: hypothesis patterns, input patterns, then supplied ordered output subset; repeat until no new parameter is bound
matching_update.signature: unchanged from early API; candidate_bindings iterable may now supply PARTIAL or COMPLETE parameter maps; [{}] requests inference without supplied residual bindings
matching_update.statuses: matching status PROPOSALS if at least one READY_PROPOSAL else UNKNOWN; matching_complete always false; finite iterator exhaustion/prefix/work bounds never absence

profile_condition: HOST_PROFILE_MEMBER means generic syntax/signature/name check only and never native bounded membership; packet host_membership_accepted=false. Host adapter must perform actual declaration/profile membership
registry: nonempty list[full descriptor], unique IDs even for identical duplicates; validates whole supplied registry including unreachable descriptors, exact actual called dependencies, cycles rejected
scope_selectors: reserved parameter IDs avoid ambiguous context selectors; ordinary port/step IDs are independently namespaced
side_condition_scope: NOT_FREE_IN/FREE_SUBSET on abstraction parameters use external free variables excluding formal_names; INPUTS/OUTPUTS are current frame formulas, GAMMA complete original host list. EIGEN additionally absent from every root input formula. No implicit discharge
source_identity: root input source is full literal provenance identity, not standardized {input:portID}. DISTINCT compares external full source JSON or primitive node IDs through nested aliases. Same external source with unequal literal formulas rejects. Metadata is still unauthenticated until host adapter
work: own guarded syntax steps, independent checker need not reproduce implementation-specific work count. Compare all substantive proposal fields EXCEPT work; verify work shape/bounds and retain as untrusted diagnostic. Structural costs independently reproducible
